# Rune

> A tiny, native coding agent harness in Rust. One binary for interactive terminal sessions, scripts, and embedding.

Rune connects to the model provider you choose. Permission rules, configuration,
and limits report their sources. Shell commands use the platform sandbox where
available. The landing page includes a WebAssembly demo of the harness.

## Website

- [Home](https://rune.heyaadi.com/): Overview of Rune.
- [Demo](https://rune.heyaadi.com/#demo): Run the harness in the page.
- [Features](https://rune.heyaadi.com/#why): Build budgets, sandboxing, permissions, and supported hosts.
- [Install](https://rune.heyaadi.com/#start): Install and connect a provider.

## Repository documentation

- [README](https://github.com/AadiXC0DE/Rune/blob/main/README.md): Installation, usage, configuration, and embedding.
- [Command reference](https://github.com/AadiXC0DE/Rune/blob/main/COMMANDS.md): Generated command, flag, and limit documentation.
- [Source](https://github.com/AadiXC0DE/Rune): Rust workspace and development instructions.
- [Releases](https://github.com/AadiXC0DE/Rune/releases): Native release artifacts.
